title: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI relies on a world-writable /tmp file unless XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set,…
description: Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) versions before 5.2.0 have a vulnerability where RXAPI uses a world-writable /tmp file unless the environment variable XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set. This allows any local user to communicate with RXAPI, potentially injecting a macro that a REXX script will execute.
